title: Platform Engine Modernization & Performance Boost
highlights: Upgraded core backend platform to .NET 10 LTS for blazing-fast response times and minimal server overhead.
Synchronized frontend Angular framework to v21.2.22 for silky-smooth client rendering.
Overhauled real-time room synchronization to an event-driven push architecture, delivering instantaneous action broadcasts with zero lag.
Eliminated reflection bottlenecks in real-time game state delivery for high-concurrency multiplayer sessions.

title: End-to-End Real-Time Multiplayer Test Suite
highlights: Added multi-client browser testing to guarantee connection reliability across all devices.
Hardened room lifecycle, lobby joins, and game transitions under concurrent load.

title: Clover-Minded Experience & UI Polish
highlights: Enhanced So Clover (Clover-Minded) card rotation and submission mechanics.
Refined mobile phone touch controls and responsive layouts for party play.
